description: mailbox.rs role_to_wire ends with '_ => unreachable!("unhandled MailboxRole variant; update role_to_wire")'. MailboxRole is #[non_exhaustive] with an Other(s) catch-all; a future crate update that adds a named variant (e.g. MailboxRole::Scheduled) will hit this arm and panic in production without a compile error on the consumer side. The _ arm should map to 'other.as_str()' or call serde_json::to_value to obtain the wire string rather than panicking.
title: role_to_wire unreachable! panics in production if MailboxRole gains new variant
